subject: Draft: Product tile copy, regional CTAs, and pricing visibility for AWS listing
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: lara.chen@stellarai.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-08T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Product tile copy, regional CTAs, and pricing visibility for AWS listing

Hi Lara + team,

Attached is a near-final draft of the AWS product tile and suggested product-page snippets. Key asks:
- Do we surface hourly vs. monthly pricing on the tile? (Stellar prefers monthly list price for customer-facing pages.)
- For US vs. EU regions, do you want separate CTAs ("Start free trial" / "Contact sales") or a single CTA with region-aware routing?

Highlights in the attachments:
- product_tile_v3.png: hero line + 2 short benefit bullets we propose for the listing.
- pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx: proposed SKU mapping (BYO-model degrees) and pricing buckets.
- aws_listing_checklist.pdf: ops items we need from procurement/Security to complete the listing.

Proposed timeline: finalize copy by Fri 9/11 so we can submit to Marketplace review next week.

Next steps from us: Kimberly to confirm final headline + 2nd benefit bullet; Jonas to run quick legal/claims sanity check.

Lara, can you confirm whether procurement will require a PrivateOffer flow or standard listing? If PrivateOffer, we should expose a separate CTA that routes to your procurement contact (procurement@stellarai.com) + include the trial terms.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: product_tile_v3.png (image)
Attachment: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: aws_listing_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: lara.chen@stellarai.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stellarai.com
Date: 2026-09-09T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Product tile copy, regional CTAs, and pricing visibility for AWS listing

Thanks, Markus — looks strong. Quick answers from our side:

- Pricing visibility: customer teams prefer a monthly list price on the product tile for buyer comparability. We can surface hourly under the pricing details page.
- CTAs: We'd like region-specific routing. For US and APAC, show "Start free trial". For EU, show "Contact procurement" that opens a pre-populated email to procurement@stellarai.com (we have some contractual nuances in the EU).
- PrivateOffer: Yes — we want PrivateOffer enabled for enterprise deals > $50k ARR. That will require a PO flow on your end and DocuSign integration.

Procurement is looped — they'll follow up on the evidence checklist.

Lara Chen
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Stellar Analytics

(Internal note: procurement@stellarai.com will also ask for data residency language and SOC2 evidence.)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, lara.chen@stellarai.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, procurement@stellarai.com
Date: 2026-09-09T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Product tile copy, regional CTAs, and pricing visibility for AWS listing

Nice — a few concrete edits from PM/Listing ops perspective:

1) Hero headline: shorten to "Low-latency LLM inference for product teams" (keeps claims narrow and defensible).
2) Benefit bullets: keep one technical ("Guaranteed p99 latency under 150ms on Dedicated") and one business ("Predictable cost with batching and reserved pools").
3) CTA routing: implement a single CTA component that accepts a region prop; on EU, CTA text should read "Contact procurement" and open a mailto that includes "PrivateOffer request" in the subject line. That avoids two tile variants and keeps the UX consistent.
4) Pricing visibility: show monthly list price on tile + a small footnote that says "Contact sales for committed pricing and PrivateOffer options" (link to PrivateOffer flow).

Jonas — can you confirm there's no legal red flag with the p99 claim? If not, we can lock copy.

I'll update the product_tile_v4.png with the shorter headline and the CTA behavior and push to the Drive folder by EOD.

Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_microcopy_changes.txt (text)
